summary: Test-writing run for issue #39 (commit 7bbcf69). Parity corpus fixture committed from viamin/color_matching (priv/parity/v1/corpus.json, algorithm_version 1) with a permanent solver-parity test target (6/6 green: exact scores, earliest-wins ties, exclusions, weight handling, solver fast-path replay). PaletteAPIClient wire contract pinned by 7 new tests (9/9 green) and the disk cache re-verified (69/69 green). Three structural tests for the generated OpenAPI client adoption fail as expected (red-phase evidence that swift-openapi-generator/runtime, the committed OpenAPI document, and the migrated client are not in place yet). Verified on a Swift 6.4.2 linux toolchain via the repo's bin/lint portable-subset harness plus a second harness including PaletteAPIClient and its tests; BrightnessGridSampler.swift (CoreGraphics) cannot compile off-Apple. Fixed a pre-existing compile error in PaletteAPIClientTests.swift:32 (implicit self in an escaping closure; no CI compiles tests today). Full swift test on macOS remains the authoritative gate.
